summary: Added a non-disruptive reload path that re-fetches browser-extension bundles and workspace activation state without reconnecting or restarting any running Pi session. Exposed the action via a new `/reload` slash command in the Composer and a 'Reload extensions' entry in the command palette.
decisions: Implement reload as a client-side re-installation of web extensions and project activation state rather than a full reconnect, so running Pi agents stay intact.
Expose the reload action both as a Composer slash command (`/reload`) and as a 'Reload extensions' command-palette item.
Cover reload behaviour with a new AgentStore test verifying that `reloadExtensions()` preserves `sessionId` and connection state.
